BatchGet.description_en: Exports monitoring data defined in the Cursor operation
BatchGet.description_zh: 导出在Cursor接口中定义的监控数据

Cursor.description_en: Defines the scope of monitoring data to export and returns the Cursor parameter for the initial call to the BatchGet operation
Cursor.description_zh: 定义导出监控数据的范围并返回用于初始调用BatchGet接口的Cursor参数
